title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: claim documents, survey reports and service days by tier
content:
## Scope

This table belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line and gives, for every tier, the documents deadline after notice, the survey report requirements, the service standard for deciding a claim, and the period for paying an approved settlement.

## Tier table

| Tier | Documents due after notice | Survey report required above claimed amount | Kinds of loss always needing a survey report | Decision service standard after documents complete | Payment of an approved settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | 60 calendar days | 5000.00 USD | total loss, contamination | 30 days | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | 60 calendar days | 5000.00 USD | total loss, contamination | 30 days | 30 calendar days |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | 90 calendar days | 7500.00 USD | total loss | 21 days | 21 calendar days |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | 90 calendar days | 10000.00 USD | total loss, temperature damage | 14 days | 14 calendar days |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | 120 calendar days | 15000.00 USD | temperature damage | 10 days | 10 calendar days |
| AHL CargoCare Total | 120 calendar days | 25000.00 USD | none | 7 days | 7 calendar days |

## Definitions

- **Documents due after notice**: the calendar days after the notice by which the claim documents must be complete.
- **Survey report required above claimed amount**: the claimed amount, per claim, above which a survey report is a required document.
- **Kinds of loss always needing a survey report**: the kinds of loss for which a survey report is always required.
- **Decision service standard**: the service standard, in days, for deciding a claim once its documents are complete.
- **Payment of an approved settlement**: the calendar days after approval within which an approved settlement is paid.

## Points of judgement

**On AHL CargoCare Total, is a survey report ever required?** Only when the claimed amount is above 25000.00 USD; no kind of loss always needs one on that tier.

**On AHL CargoCare Essential, does a contamination claim always need a survey report?** Not by kind of loss; only total loss always needs one on that tier.
